title: Section 445.10 – Revise the Informational Note in Section 445.10 to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: See NFPA 37, Standard for the Installation and Use of Stationary Combustion Engines and Gas
Turbines, for information on the location of generator exhaust. Also see New York City Mechanical Code Chapter 8,
Section MC 811.
